resources.string: Friends scan this to chat with you for free over Nostr.
ZCHAT only. It carries your messaging key, so a contact can message you free from the first message. It is not a payment address: to receive ZEC, use the Receive ZEC tab.
Receive ZEC — any wallet can pay this
Any wallet can scan this QR or paste the address to send you ZEC.
Transparent addresses are only for receiving ZEC from exchanges or services that don\'t support shielded addresses.
You cannot send ZCHAT messages from transparent funds. Received ZEC will need to be shielded before you can use it for private messaging.
Share this address to receive ZEC. Messages sent to it are Shielded (on-chain, paid by the sender). For free chats, share your Free chat code.
All funds received at this address can be used for private ZCHAT messaging.
